metadata.description: Agent-facing tooling for the Apiguru Amazon Data API.

plugins.name: apiguru
plugins.description: Live Amazon marketplace data across 20 countries - product details, prices, reviews, search, best-sellers, deals, live offers and stock, and seller profiles. Callable with no API key: unkeyed agents get free probes, then pay per call via x402 (USDC on Base). The bundled MCP server is launched with `uvx apiguru-mcp` (needs uv; or `pip install apiguru-mcp` and point the server at `apiguru-mcp`).
